topFinding: *On T-0 day itself, the run reframes the propositions narrative as pipeline transition from adoption to operational implementation: TA-10-2026-0096 ceases to be a parliamentary file and becomes a Commission implementing-acts file — and the EP's role pivots from legislative author to scrutiny-of-implementation actor.
keyTakeaways: 🔴 **T-0 today — TA-10-2026-0096 transitions to implementing acts.** EP's role pivots adoption → scrutiny.
